description: The ready WakeHuBERT streaming 'aufwachen' model at its own calibrated default threshold (0.5).
notes: models.json at 2ac92d3b: featurizer wakehubert-int8. Threshold, smoothing and debounce come from the model's own metadata. Training data per models.json: synthetic only: OmniVoice no-reference clips, one seed per clip, checked against a speech recogniser transcript, and the OmniVoice donor clips of TigreGotico/synthetic-wakeword-aufwachen train/omnivoice: the train split of TigreGotico/synthetic-wakeword-aufwachen at revision 04b68d6f596cd38b5c46f4ea73cab524adeebbeb, which holds byte for byte the local copies wakeup-localised/de/train and omnivoice-donor-synthesis/de/aufwachen, with one voice in ten held out; mixed into 30 s synthetic streams (LibriSpeech train-clean-100, KWS windows, AudioSet noise, RIR); streamed WakeHuBERT-tiny int8 features.
